mentions.name: Janus
mentions.description: This app is a notebook for interview preparation: it records interview conversations, provides useful feedback on them, and helps users prepare for their next interview round.
mentions.problem: Interviews leave you guessing, without useful feedback on how the conversation went.
mentions.source_excerpt: A notebook for the interviews that leave you guessing. Record the conversation, get useful feedback, and prepare for your next round.
mentions.author: kcirtapfrmspc
